name: structures
description: Document project architecture with Structures profiles and generate Conventional Commit messages.

interface.shortDescription: Document project architecture and prepare commits
interface.longDescription: Analyze a local project or related repositories, explain their architecture, and generate settings.json with inline documentation plus a Markdown overview. Publish the files as a GitHub Gist when requested, then load the profile in Structures. Generate Conventional Commit messages using repository rules, preview them in chat, or create a local commit with --push.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this project and generate a documented Structures profile ready for a GitHub Gist.
Generate a Conventional Commit message for the current changes using this project's commit rules.
